requirement: Add an ad blocker to the Puzzle Date Chrome extension without affecting ordinary browsing.

architecture.decision: Use a per-tab Manifest V3 session DNR block rule activated only by the trusted Puzzle Date top-frame content script, plus narrowly scoped cosmetic CSS injected only into child frames of that enabled tab.
seams: Ad blocking must be scoped to Puzzle Date/localhost tabs and automatically removed when the tab closes.
Do not alter cookies, consent choices, storage, normal browsing, or the existing reset/embedding protocols.
Block only a reviewed list of ad-serving domains and hide common ad containers inside embedded game frames.

tasks.title: Implement scoped ad blocking
tasks.intent: Activate per-tab network blocking and cosmetic ad hiding only for Puzzle Date tabs.
tasks.constraints: Validate trusted top-frame senders; use session rules with tabIds; clean up on tab close; never accept cookie dialogs or clear storage; preserve reset and embedding behavior.
tasks.acceptance: A trusted Puzzle Date tab installs a tab-scoped session rule for reviewed ad domains, child frames receive cosmetic CSS, non-Puzzle Date tabs cannot enable it, and closing the tab removes its rule.
tasks.verify: npm run validate:extension && node --check chrome-extension/background.js && node --check chrome-extension/content.js
tasks.result: Implemented trusted-sender activation of per-tab session DNR ad rules, automatic tab-close cleanup, and cosmetic CSS limited to child frames; validators pin the reviewed domains/resource types and forbid cookie, consent, or storage manipulation.

tasks.title: Package and document the ad-blocking release
tasks.intent: Bump the extension version, update user-facing copy, regenerate the ZIP, and publish the tested release.
tasks.constraints: Clearly describe that blocking applies only inside Puzzle Date; do not claim cookie consent removal; keep the stable unpacked folder synchronized.
tasks.acceptance: The app popup and guide advertise the new version and scoped ad blocking, the public ZIP exactly contains the validated extension, and the stable unpacked folder matches it.
tasks.verify: npm run validate:extension && npm run package:extension && npm run build:pages && unzip -t public/downloads/puzzle-date-game-reset.zip
tasks.visual: Reload the unpacked extension, open Puzzle Date in Chrome, and verify ads are absent or blocked without breaking game frames.
tasks.result: Released extension 1.0.7 with scoped ad-blocking copy across the manifest, app modal, README, and install guide; regenerated the four-file ZIP and passed validation, Pages build, archive integrity/listing, and diff checks.
